falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above the 200-day moving average by 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A clear bullish breakout would invalidate the 'HOLD' signal by demonstrating sustained upward momentum contrary to the pattern's implied consolidation.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 14-day average trading volume for the NASDAQ surges to 150% of its 90-day average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Excessive volume would indicate strong conviction in a directional move, contradicting the 'UNKNOWN' phase's implied indecision.

falsification_conditions.condition: The CBOE VIX index drops below 12 for three consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained period of extreme low volatility would falsify the 'HOLD' signal by proving the pattern's implied risk-on environment is incorrect.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
